It comes with a water bucket-like thing, and I highly recommend it to people who find it bothersome to even pour it in. (The type who can't even put soju in their mouths, they just swallow it.) And I tend to run the dishwasher right away, so there aren't many things that get stuck, so I only run it on the rapid setting. Even though I don't wash the dishes by hand, I didn't buy it to wash them in the machine for hours. Oh, but it feels like using the rapid setting of the washing machine when I do slightly less dirty laundry? This is really great because the rapid setting is already sterilized at 65 degrees anyway, so if I don't see even the slightest bit of dirt, I could become a pig licking the dishes again, but it washes well and finishes in 30 minutes. If I watch something like a variety show, it'll go off in 30 minutes so quickly that it'll start beeping right away. If I can just quickly improve my Tetris skills, it's actually better than Rocheong. But this is a bit of a downside. It cleans well even on fast mode, so I just keep it on fast mode all the time. I don't know about other modes, but I guess it'll get cleaner if I just run it for a long time. And the automatic door opening function is really nice, I feel like I'm receiving a favor. I used to use a Cuckoo Marshmallow for a single-person household, but the automatic door opening didn't work, so I had to sell it used because I had time. But this one automatically turns on the fan and opens the door when it's done, which is really nice. The water stream feels stronger, maybe because of my mood. Anyway, I've been reborn as a human being thanks to this. I'm not very good at Tetris. [Cons] It costs 300,000 won, not 30,000 won. I work from home a lot, so I often eat three meals at home. I'm a minimalist who's a machine person, so instead of the automatic water dispenser, I put the water in myself. Since the dishwasher isn't heavy, it's easy to move. I just turn the direction of the dishwasher slightly and drag it to the sink faucet to fill it right away. This is so convenient. It comes with a water bucket-like thing, and I highly recommend it to people who find it bothersome to even pour it in. (The type who can't even put soju in their mouths, they just swallow it.) And I tend to run the dishwasher right away, so there aren't many things that get stuck, so I only run it on the rapid setting. Even though I don't wash the dishes by hand, I didn't buy it to wash them in the machine for hours. Oh, but it feels like using the rapid setting of the washing machine when I do slightly less dirty laundry? This is really great because the rapid setting is already sterilized at 65 degrees anyway, so if I don't see even the slightest bit of dirt, I could become a pig licking the dishes again, but it washes well and finishes in 30 minutes. If I watch something like a variety show, it'll go off in 30 minutes so quickly that it'll start beeping right away. If I can just quickly improve my Tetris skills, it's actually better than Rocheong. But this is a bit of a downside. It cleans well even on fast mode, so I just keep it on fast mode all the time. I don't know about other modes, but I guess it'll get cleaner if I just run it for a long time. And the automatic door opening function is really nice, I feel like I'm receiving a favor. I used to use a Cuckoo Marshmallow for a single-person household, but the automatic door opening didn't work, so I had to sell it used because I had time. But this one automatically turns on the fan and opens the door when it's done, which is really nice. The water stream feels stronger, maybe because of my mood. Anyway, I've been reborn as a human being thanks to this. Cooking time 30 minutes - Eating time 10 minutes - Washing time 20 minutes ----------------------- = 0 This was so unfair, but now I'm moving on. Minix is the best. Sell a lot~~~~~

Comments (English): [ I feel like I've been promoted from a dish-pile-up pig to a human. ] || ---------------- || I'm so impressed with the Minix dishwasher [Pros] The water supply has been reorganized. It washes dishes well even in quick mode. It has an automatic door opening function, so there's no need for extra time. It's small, so it's easy to place in a small kitchen. I'm not very good at Tetris. [Cons] It costs 300,000 won, not 30,000 won. I work from home a lot, so I often eat three meals at home. When I eat, the dishes pile up like a rock in Ulsan, and I get dizzy because I don't know if I'm eating to work or working to eat. But the Minix dishwasher solves this. I wanted to buy charcoal at first, but since my kitchen is white, I bought greige because I was worried I'd end up like a black-and-white chef. It's compact, so I'm happy that it fits well in my already compact kitchen. (I really measured the length before buying it, but I couldn't let go of my tension until I unpacked and put it away.) I'm a minimalist who's a machine person, so instead of the automatic water dispenser, I put the water in myself. Since the dishwasher isn't heavy, it's easy to move. I just turn the direction of the dishwasher slightly and drag it to the sink faucet to fill it right away. This is so convenient. It comes with a water bucket-like thing, and I highly recommend it to people who find it bothersome to even pour it in. (The type who can't even put soju in their mouths, they just swallow it.) And I tend to run the dishwasher right away, so there aren't many things that get stuck, so I only run it on the rapid setting. Even though I don't wash the dishes by hand, I didn't buy it to wash them in the machine for hours. Oh, but it feels like using the rapid setting of the washing machine when I do slightly less dirty laundry? This is really great because the rapid setting is already sterilized at 65 degrees anyway, so if I don't see even the slightest bit of dirt, I could become a pig licking the dishes again, but it washes well and finishes in 30 minutes. If I watch something like a variety show, it'll go off in 30 minutes so quickly that it'll start beeping right away. If I can just quickly improve my Tetris skills, it's actually better than Rocheong. But this is a bit of a downside. It cleans well even on fast mode, so I just keep it on fast mode all the time. I don't know about other modes, but I guess it'll get cleaner if I just run it for a long time. And the automatic door opening function is really nice, I feel like I'm receiving a favor. I used to use a Cuckoo Marshmallow for a single-person household, but the automatic door opening didn't work, so I had to sell it used because I had time. But this one automatically turns on the fan and opens the door when it's done, which is really nice. The water stream feels stronger, maybe because of my mood. Anyway, I've been reborn as a human being thanks to this. Cooking time 30 minutes - Eating time 10 minutes - Washing time 20 minutes ----------------------- = 0 This was so unfair, but now I'm moving on. Minix is the best. Sell a lot~~~~~

I'm not very good at Tetris. [Cons] It costs 300,000 won, not 30,000 won. I work from home a lot, so I often eat three meals at home. I wanted to buy charcoal at first, but since my kitchen is white, I bought greige because I was worried I'd end up like a black-and-white chef. It's compact, so I'm happy that it fits well in my already compact kitchen. (I really measured the length before buying it, but I couldn't let go of my tension until I unpacked and put it away.) I'm a minimalist who's a machine person, so instead of the automatic water dispenser, I put the water in myself. Since the dishwasher isn't heavy, it's easy to move. I just turn the direction of the dishwasher slightly and drag it to the sink faucet to fill it right away. This is so convenient. It comes with a water bucket-like thing, and I highly recommend it to people who find it bothersome to even pour it in. (The type who can't even put soju in their mouths, they just swallow it.) And I tend to run the dishwasher right away, so there aren't many things that get stuck, so I only run it on the rapid setting. Even though I don't wash the dishes by hand, I didn't buy it to wash them in the machine for hours. Oh, but it feels like using the rapid setting of the washing machine when I do slightly less dirty laundry? This is really great because the rapid setting is already sterilized at 65 degrees anyway, so if I don't see even the slightest bit of dirt, I could become a pig licking the dishes again, but it washes well and finishes in 30 minutes. If I watch something like a variety show, it'll go off in 30 minutes so quickly that it'll start beeping right away. If I can just quickly improve my Tetris skills, it's actually better than Rocheong. But this is a bit of a downside. It cleans well even on fast mode, so I just keep it on fast mode all the time. I don't know about other modes, but I guess it'll get cleaner if I just run it for a long time. And the automatic door opening function is really nice, I feel like I'm receiving a favor. I used to use a Cuckoo Marshmallow for a single-person household, but the automatic door opening didn't work, so I had to sell it used because I had time. But this one automatically turns on the fan and opens the door when it's done, which is really nice. The water stream feels stronger, maybe because of my mood. Anyway, I've been reborn as a human being thanks to this. Cooking time 30 minutes - Eating time 10 minutes - Washing time 20 minutes ----------------------- = 0 This was so unfair, but now I'm moving on. Minix is the best. Sell a lot~~~~~

Comments (English): [ I feel like I've been promoted from a dish-pile-up pig to a human. ] || ---------------- || I'm so impressed with the Minix dishwasher [Pros] The water supply has been reorganized. It washes dishes well even in quick mode. It has an automatic door opening function, so there's no need for extra time. It's small, so it's easy to place in a small kitchen. I'm not very good at Tetris. [Cons] It costs 300,000 won, not 30,000 won. I work from home a lot, so I often eat three meals at home. When I eat, the dishes pile up like a rock in Ulsan, and I get dizzy because I don't know if I'm eating to work or working to eat. But the Minix dishwasher solves this. I wanted to buy charcoal at first, but since my kitchen is white, I bought greige because I was worried I'd end up like a black-and-white chef. It's compact, so I'm happy that it fits well in my already compact kitchen. (I really measured the length before buying it, but I couldn't let go of my tension until I unpacked and put it away.) I'm a minimalist who's a machine person, so instead of the automatic water dispenser, I put the water in myself. Since the dishwasher isn't heavy, it's easy to move. I just turn the direction of the dishwasher slightly and drag it to the sink faucet to fill it right away. This is so convenient. It comes with a water bucket-like thing, and I highly recommend it to people who find it bothersome to even pour it in. (The type who can't even put soju in their mouths, they just swallow it.) And I tend to run the dishwasher right away, so there aren't many things that get stuck, so I only run it on the rapid setting. Even though I don't wash the dishes by hand, I didn't buy it to wash them in the machine for hours. Oh, but it feels like using the rapid setting of the washing machine when I do slightly less dirty laundry? This is really great because the rapid setting is already sterilized at 65 degrees anyway, so if I don't see even the slightest bit of dirt, I could become a pig licking the dishes again, but it washes well and finishes in 30 minutes. If I watch something like a variety show, it'll go off in 30 minutes so quickly that it'll start beeping right away. If I can just quickly improve my Tetris skills, it's actually better than Rocheong. But this is a bit of a downside. It cleans well even on fast mode, so I just keep it on fast mode all the time. I don't know about other modes, but I guess it'll get cleaner if I just run it for a long time. And the automatic door opening function is really nice, I feel like I'm receiving a favor. I used to use a Cuckoo Marshmallow for a single-person household, but the automatic door opening didn't work, so I had to sell it used because I had time. But this one automatically turns on the fan and opens the door when it's done, which is really nice. The water stream feels stronger, maybe because of my mood. Anyway, I've been reborn as a human being thanks to this. Cooking time 30 minutes - Eating time 10 minutes - Washing time 20 minutes ----------------------- = 0 This was so unfair, but now I'm moving on. Minix is the best. Sell a lot~~~~~

It was an upgrade as part of our new home build in late 2022. It was decent at cleaning for a bit, but even using Cascade Platinum Plus plus Finish Rinse Aid, it was always a guess if the load would be clean or completely dry. The Normal option would clean the bottom rack relatively well, but the top rack was still dirty and greasy, and the utensil rack at the top top was almost never clean. I feel GE should really recall these units if it's a widespread issue only after a short period. Or honor an extended warranty.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher seems good, store experience was bad ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher in for about a week and so far it seems good. It's very quiet, cycles are much faster than the one I replaced. I will say even with the extended drying option the top 2 rack does tend to be wet at the end of the cycle.My MAJOR negative is I spent a lot of time at the store looking at the dishwasher that had the sign for this dishwasher on it. I made my decision based on the display dishwasher with this sign on it. Once it was installed I realized it wasn't the same as the one we looked at in the store. I went back and looked at the one in the store and found out it was a kitchenaid kdtm740kps but the digital display was for the kitchenaid kdtm404kps model. We had even made a point to ask the employee what the difference was between the two floor models that were both labeled kdtm404kps was and they responded "nothing, they are the same." We spent all the time looking at the one we did because the other one was missing the middle (top) rack so we looked at the second one that had the top rack so we could judge if our dishes and stuff would fit in it and confirm the top rack was moveable, etc. When I went back to see why the one in my house was missing features from the display model I mentioned to the employee that the digital sign was wrong. I was told they don't control the signs. Kind of feels like false advertising. I wasn't aware I needed to check the floor model model number to confirm it was what the sign directly above it advertised it as before making decisions.

Sentence (English): Purchased this unit after a previous GE dishwasher gave it up.
Comments (English): Purchased this unit after a previous GE dishwasher gave it up. I went back with a GE as the previous one I had lasted for 15+ years without any issues or service calls in that time. Sentence (English): The basic dishwashing function is quite good.
Comments (English): [ Delay feature needs improvement ] || ---------------- || The basic dishwashing functionality is quite good. It's a quiet machine and the drying works well when using the Crystal Dry option. The racks are well arranged and tines fold down to work with Asian style bowls so I generally have space to fit all my dishes. A minor quibble is that this dishwasher requires dishwasher salt, which as far as I can tell is not commonly sold in stores so it has to be bought online. A bigger annoyance is how the delay feature works. There are 2 ways to delay washing for folks who live with time of use electric rate schedules. First is setting the delay via a button on the door. This would be ok except Bosch for some reason made the delay increment in minutes instead of hours like every other dishwasher. So delaying by 5 hours is just a pointlessly slow exercise. I don't see why anyone would care for per minute precision in dishwasher delay. The second method requires pairing the dishwasher with your phone, and setting a schedule on the phone. This sounds great except you must use your phone every time to start the dishwasher! Then the phone will just wait until the scheduled time to actually start it. If that sounds annoying to do, that's because it is. I only took one star off for this obnoxiousness because it is possible to get it to start daily at midnight by just using the "manual remote start" feature and tying that to an automation I set up in Google Home. Same thing can be done in Alexa or Homekit. So now I just push the remote button on the door instead of start and Google Home will start it at midnight. If not for this saving grace I would have seriously considered returning this dishwasher.

It's a quiet machine and the drying works well when using the Crystal Dry option. The racks are well arranged and tines fold down to work with Asian style bowls so I generally have space to fit all my dishes. A minor quibble is that this dishwasher requires dishwasher salt, which as far as I can tell is not commonly sold in stores so it has to be bought online. A bigger annoyance is how the delay feature works. There are 2 ways to delay washing for folks who live with time of use electric rate schedules. First is setting the delay via a button on the door. This would be ok except Bosch for some reason made the delay increment in minutes instead of hours like every other dishwasher. So delaying by 5 hours is just a pointlessly slow exercise. I don't see why anyone would care for per minute precision in dishwasher delay. The second method requires pairing the dishwasher with your phone, and setting a schedule on the phone. This sounds great except you must use your phone every time to start the dishwasher! Then the phone will just wait until the scheduled time to actually start it. If that sounds annoying to do, that's because it is. I only took one star off for this obnoxiousness because it is possible to get it to start daily at midnight by just using the "manual remote start" feature and tying that to an automation I set up in Google Home. Same thing can be done in Alexa or Homekit. So now I just push the remote button on the door instead of start and Google Home will start it at midnight. If not for this saving grace I would have seriously considered returning this dishwasher.

A bigger annoyance is how the delay feature works. There are 2 ways to delay washing for folks who live with time of use electric rate schedules. First is setting the delay via a button on the door. This would be ok except Bosch for some reason made the delay increment in minutes instead of hours like every other dishwasher. So delaying by 5 hours is just a pointlessly slow exercise. I don't see why anyone would care for per minute precision in dishwasher delay. The second method requires pairing the dishwasher with your phone, and setting a schedule on the phone. Same thing can be done in Alexa or Homekit. So now I just push the remote button on the door instead of start and Google Home will start it at midnight. If not for this saving grace I would have seriously considered returning this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This is replacing a 20 year old Frigidaire.
Comments (English): [ Great Performance ] || ---------------- || This is replacing a 20 year old Frigidaire. Love the extra space that the design and third rack brings. At 44dBa it's pretty darn quiet. Using pro wash and extended dry with just liquid detergent plus rinse aid does a great job of getting everything clean and dry, even plastic. It is annoying that you only get a 4 hour delay choice. The biggest design flaw I've seen is the pump screen design. Some have had to take it apart and clean it out due to excessive food debris build up causing the basin not to drain. I think so long as you don't load it up all the time with dishes still heavily covered with food it'll be fine. It was honestly between the Whirlpool/KitchenAid and a Bosch. We decided to take a chance on the KitchenAid due to the better third rack design plus having a utensils basket. Time will tell if it'll last 20 years also, but very happy performance-wise thus far after about a month.

Sentence (English): The good: First of all, the drying is excellent.
Comments (English): [ I have this Bosch SMD8TCX01E dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The good: First of all, the drying is excellent. The PerfectDry function, which uses Zeolith, really makes a difference – plates, glasses, even plastic casseroles come out completely dry. I don't have to stand around wiping dishes at the end, which is a relief. I also like how quiet it is. At 43 dB, it's barely audible, even when I'm standing in the kitchen. I've also used the Silence program a few times and it was even quieter. Another plus is the flexibility of the baskets. I can adjust the height of the top rack (even when it's full) and arrange large plates or saucepans without any problems. For someone who washes dishes of different sizes, this makes a big difference. The Home Connect function is interesting – it's not something I could live without, but it's useful when I want to start the machine remotely or check how long the program is. What I don't like so much: The installation was a bit difficult. If you don't have experience with built-in appliances, you might get a little nervous until you get it set up perfectly. The price is also quite high. It's a serious investment, and if you're not interested in advanced features, you can find cheaper models that do the job just fine. In addition, some programs take quite a long time. The eco program, for example, can exceed 3 hours. If you're in a hurry, you have to settle for the quick programs, which aren't always as efficient. Conclusion: Overall, I'm happy with the Bosch SMD8TCX01E. It does what it promises: it washes and dries very well, it's quiet, and it offers a lot of flexibility. If you have the budget for it and want a reliable appliance, it's worth the money.

Am folosit și programul Silence de câteva ori și a fost și mai liniște.Un alt plus e flexibilitatea coșurilor. Pentru cine spală vase de diverse mărimi, asta contează mult.Funcția Home Connect e interesantă – nu e ceva fără de care n-aș putea trăi, dar e utilă când vreau să pornesc mașina de la distanță sau să verific cât mai durează programul.Ce nu-mi place atât de mult:Instalarea a fost cam dificilă. Dacă nu ai experiență cu electrocasnice încorporabile, s-ar putea să te enervezi puțin până o montezi perfect.De asemenea, prețul e destul de mare. E o investiție serioasă, iar dacă nu ești interesat de funcții avansate, poți găsi modele mai ieftine care își fac treaba bine.În plus, unele programe durează destul de mult. Sentence (English): The Bosch 500 series dishwasher is quiet and cleans all of my dishes, glassware and baby bottles really well even without me having to pre rinse dishes.
Comments (English): The Bosch 500 series dishwasher is quiet and cleans all of my dishes, glassware and baby bottles really well even without me having to pre rinse dishes. We primarily replaced our old dishwasher for extra cleaning performance and for the third rack which easily fits the baby bottle parts for our newborn. I found cleaning the filter every couple weeks is best because I don't prewash my dishes and it usually needs it to maintain cleaning performance. The auto air feature works great if you allow it to do its thing overnight. In the morning everything is really dry including plastic parts for the most part. The Home Connect app is great at managing various settings for the dishwasher like the rinse aid amount and using the delay start option. Overall I am really happy with the cleaning performance and the extra space this dishwasher allows.

Sentence (English): I bought the predecessor, a 800 series SHV78B73UC, in the beginning of October this year.
Comments (English): [ Very disappointed ] || ---------------- || I bought the predecessor, a 800 series SHV78B73UC, in the beginning of October this year. Unfortunately Hurricane Milton hit just 1 week later and flooded the brand new machine. The official replacement model is called SHX78CM5N. I'm very very disappointed with the changes which have been made: 1. No water softener any more (now only available in the very expensive Benchmark series) 2. Racks have been changed to the worse. Much more flimsy, don't glide any more as well as the old ones did (but now you can get the Benchmark series for much more money with 'easy glide plus'), and even worse: The product comparison sheet online says all 800 series come with AquaStop - however the machine we got installed came with/o it and it seems like this unique feature has been discontinued, too. The installers said they have never seen this model so far with Aquastop. I contacted Bosch Service first through the hotline - they insist the machine should have Aquastop although it hasn't. Contacted afterwards Bosch Service online through their Service page and asked for a clear info if this machine has Aquastop. 1 week and no answer - just a 'thank you for contacting us' message. This is unacceptable. Bosch has clearly changed the 800 series to the worse instead of to the better. Not a good ratio project. I'm curious if there is any reaction on this review.

Sentence (English): Disappointing Installation, Design, and QualityI had high expectations for this dishwasher purchase from Costco because of the hype which was replacing our 8 years old Samsung dishwasher which finally gave in, but the entire experience has been disappointing.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing Design, Quality and Installation ] || ---------------- || Disappointing Installation, Design, and QualityI had high expectations for this dishwasher purchase from Costco because of the hype which was replacing our 8 years old Samsung dishwasher which finally gave in, but the entire experience has been disappointing. First, the installation process was frustrating. I wasn't aware Costco uses third-party companies for delivery and installation, and the lack of communication and unprofessional practices led to a delay. The promised delivery and installation date was not honored, and I had to call many times to make sure they will at least install it the next day. This unprofessional practice was a hassle and not what I expect from Costco.As for the dishwasher itself, the design and quality are underwhelming. The interior racking system is no better than cheaper models—if not worse. Like another reviewer mentioned, the oversized utensil basket seems unnecessary, especially when there's a dedicated third rack. The choice of materials also reflects the lack of quality. The plastic parts feel cheap, and the stainless steel outer door panel is flimsy. When I tried to close the door by pushing the panel instead of the bar, it felt like I was going to bend the door—it's that poorly made. You would buy two dishwasher for this price and I am almost certain they will combined outlive this Bosch 800 model.Overall, I'm disappointed with both the service and the product. For the price, I expected much more. I recommend considering Whirlpool or Samsung, and if needed higher tier quality go for KitchenAids higher models instead, as this model doesn't justify the cost. Costco should improve transparency about their installation process and prioritize carrying higher-quality appliances.

Sentence (English): I bought this to replace a 7 year old Thermador with a leaking water heater, which is basically a Bosch with blue light instead of red and the Thermador logo.
Comments (English): [ Very Good Washer - but not perfect ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace a 7 year old Thermador with a leaking water heater, which is basically a Bosch with blue light instead of red and the Thermador logo. First, this is a bit quieter than my last washer. The 3rd rack for silverware is a game changer - you will not go back, kind of like if you have a French Door Fridge/ Bottom Freezer. I do think I load the machine a bit quicker, definitely love unloading the silverware as the drawer is the same height and just a quarter turn. Additionally the racks have the most adjustability I have ever encounter in a washer. I had no idea it has a water softener, which you add salt. If you look at your water company's reports you can program your water hardness into the machine so it can dispense accordingly. Overall very happy. However it does fall short in a couple of areas - 1st its not as quiet as a Bosch washer from 20+ years ago (everything behind the counter was encased in sheetmetal back then). 2nd drying falls short from my previous model. For me it only impacts glassware and mugs with water on top. Perhaps there's a setting that can improve this, but Sanitize & Extra Dry do not really help. All in all it is a good product for my 4th Bosch Dishwasher.

Sentence (English): The Whirlpool 24” stainless steel dishwasher with AI has been a marvelous addition to my home.
Comments (English): [ Incredible, quiet, effecient dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The Whirlpool 24” stainless steel dishwasher with AI has been a marvelous addition to my home. This dishwasher features 3 racks, with the 3rd being a small shelf at the very top. This feature is great, because it helps clean larger kitchen tools like tongs and spatulas, without taking up the space that would be taken by larger dishes. The center rack has tines that can be folded down, so you can put larger items in it that wouldn't normally fit with the tines up, and you can also fold them down over flat items to keep them in place inside the rack. This helps prevent anything from moving while the cycle is running. The bottom rack is very spacious and includes a removable cutlery basket, to make loading and unloading even easier. The racks glide extremely smoothly and silently. The entire process of using it is very quiet. I've never had a dishwasher that was this quiet before, and it's very nice to not have to turn up the TV or wait until right before I go to sleep to start it. The cleaning power is very impressive. Even pans with burnt on food remnants come out shining. The heated drying feature is also very convenient, and a nice touch. There's no wait time between the end of the cycle and being able to put your dishes away. There is also a delayed start feature, which I like too. You can delay the start of the wash cycle up to 24 hours in advance, so you can make sure the dishes are freshly done even when you're not home. The buttons are on the top of the door, so they're completely out of sight when it's closed. Due to the fact that it's winter time, and I've had some space heaters going, I can't accurately speak on the energy efficiency yet, but I believe it's fairly efficient in that regard. My experience with the company was great. The delivery men uninstalled my old, broken dishwasher, and hauled it away. Then they installed the new one very quickly. It was a straightforward, easy process. They were very friendly and professional, and made sure that everything was in working order before leaving. The dishwasher also came with some detergent and rinse aid, so it was ready to be used immediately. I would recommend this dishwasher to anyone who's looking to upgrade from what they have currently, or doesn't have one. It's intuitive and easy to use, so it would be good as someone's first dishwasher, but it's such a high quality that I think it'll impress someone who's had a lot of experience with dishwashers. It's overall improved my family's day to day life quite a bit.

Sentence (English): I think the machine is very good.
Comments (English): [ An inspired choice ] || ---------------- || I think the machine is very good. It is very easy to program, with or without the mobile application. It is easier to access certain functions from the application. We always use it on the same program, and when it starts, it remembers the options from the last use. It is very roomy, and the ability to fold/raise the plate/glass holders helps with better space management. The cutlery rack is very useful and very roomy. Maintaining the machine is quite easy. The water hardness in our area is very low, so the salt does not need to be replaced. The filters are very easy to remove and clean, and if you do not put dishes loaded with debris in, the filters do not get dirty too quickly. After each wash, the machine door looks impeccable, as do the dishes inside. The automatic door opening function at the end is very useful, because there is no steam left inside and you can leave the dishes in for longer, so you can put the machine to wash in the evening before going to bed or when you leave the house. The display on the floor is also very useful, because you always know when the machine is running and how much time it has left, without depending on the mobile app. The machine is quite quiet, especially if you place the dishes inside properly. If, on the other hand, you still have dishes that have play, you will hear a little noise when they are moved by the water jet.
Comments (Original): [ O alegere inspirata ] || ---------------- || Consider ca masina este foarte buna. E foarte usor de programat, cu sau fara aplicatia mobila. Din aplicatie e mai usor sa accesezi anumite functii. Noi o folosim mereu pe acelasi program, iar la pornire tine minte optiunile de la ultima utilizare. E foarte incapatoare, iar posibilitatea de a plia/rididca suporturile pentru farfurii/pahare ajuta la o mai buna gestionare a spatiului. Raftul pentru tacamuri e foarte util si foarte incapator.Intretinerea masinii e destul de usoara. La noi duritatea apei e foarte mica, asa ca nu trebuie inlocuita sarea. Filtrele se scot si curata foarte usor, iar daca nu pui vasele incarcate cu resturi, filtrele nu se murdaresc prea repede. Dupa fiecare spalare, usa masinii arata impecabil, la fel si vasele dinauntru.Functia de deschidere automata a usii la final e foarte utila, fiindca nu raman aburi inauntru si poti lasa vasele mai mult timp, asa ca poti pune masina la spalat seara inainte de culcare sau cand pleci de acasa.Afisajul de pe podea e de asemenea foarte util, fiindca stii mereu cand masina merge si cat timp mai are, fara sa depinzi de aplicatia mobila.Masina e destul de silentioasa, mai ales daca asezi bine vesele inauntru. Daca in schimb mai ai vase care au joc, se va auzi putin zgomot cand sunt miscate de jetul de apa.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher 10 months ago.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher that doesn't wash dishes ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher 10 months ago. I purchased it only because it matched our other appliances bought at Costco that are just a few years old. The GE dishwasher we bought previously needed a costly repair that would essentially equal getting a new one. I would estimate that 3-4 times per week it doesn't wash dishes (we run it nightly, so 3-4 times per week we have to run it multiple times with the same load to get dishes clean). It's as though it runs for 3 minutes then sits idle the rest of the cycle. We have had GE appliance repairmen come out twice and say the computer shows no errors, it's fine - but we need to use detergent pods (okay, done), we need to run the water in the sink very hot first (check), we need to load it precisely (check), we need to clean the filter regularly (done). I'm about to call them again and then consider just putting it on the side of the road. It was a giant waste of money, not to mention time, water, and frustration.

Comments (English): [ There is no difference from 10 years ago. ] || ---------------- || As a dishwasher user since 2010, I started with an LG dishwasher, purchased one from a different manufacturer around 2018 (since they no longer manufacture it), and then bought an LG product again. To summarize in one sentence: nothing has improved over the past 10 years. There is hardly any difference between the washing and drying performance and what it was 10 years ago. 1. Pros: Neat exterior. The lid opens automatically after washing. Since the lid opens automatically after washing, it remains closed after drying, preventing moisture from accumulating or musty odors, and seems good for maintaining the machine's condition. Compared to products from other manufacturers I have used, the interior of the drying rack feels sturdy. 2. Cons: Poor washing performance. If you don't pre-wash, food residue remains, and if you place slightly recessed side plates overlapping in the dishwashing area, they don't clean well. (Comparison with other manufacturers: It is unfair to claim that the dishes are not cleaned properly because they are sunken, as dishwashers from other manufacturers could accommodate more dishes and stack them, and most items were cleaned unless mozzarella cheese was stuck on from a microwave.) - Poor drying performance. (Comparison with other manufacturers: Previous models dried dishes thoroughly enough to be removed and placed in a cupboard immediately after drying. However, there were durability issues, such as dishes becoming too hot to touch after drying or cracks forming in the dishwasher's plastic, possibly due to this.) - Dish placement: While it may vary from person to person, arranging dishes is difficult. The mesh spacing at the bottom is wide and flat, so if dishes are placed upside down, small dishes fall through the mesh. When placed upside down, water pools on top of the dishes, resulting in incomplete drying. If the bottom section had a diagonal mesh arrangement like the top section, allowing dishes to be placed at a slight angle, water pooling during drying would likely have been less severe. 3. Overall Review: After reusing a dishwasher I had used 10 years ago, I was very disappointed to find that, as mentioned earlier, there is no difference in basic cleaning and drying performance compared to the model from 10 years ago. Sentence (English): I would say 5 stars, but I had to call a repair man to check the dishwasher upon delivery.
Comments (English): [ Great Quiet Dishwashers - Cleans Well ] || ---------------- || I would say 5 stars, but I had to call a repair man to check the dishwasher upon delivery. There is an initial resistance to the dishwasher door opening. I thought the door was locked up, so I called for service. All it turned out to be the latched system has some sort of detent system to hold door close. I was afraid to pull to hard and break something. If the machine is not leveled and fastened in position yet, you just tip over the machine trying to get the door open.All the dishwashers I used prior to this just used a spring system alone to hold the door, and they opened without strong initial resistance. They worked smoothly. I would get rid of the initial resistance design and go to spring only. Else, you are likely to have more service calls on new installations where the customer is hooking up their own dishwasher. Add to quick installation instructions to pull hard to open door while holding the dishwasher cabinet, else it falls over.

Sentence (English): I didn't realize how much dishwasher technology had changed in the past few years!
Comments (English): [ Big upgrade from my old dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I didn't realize how much dishwasher technology had changed in the past few years! My trusty old Jenn-Air finally conked out and I replaced it with this Bosch 500. I am blown away! I have not utilized all of the advanced features yet, but I love that it is so quiet that we can only tell it's running by checking to see if the red light is projected onto the floor. I mostly use the 60-minute setting, and my dishes consistently come out squeaky clean and bone dry. It's especially nice that I can load any of the three drawers with plastic items and I don't have to worry about them melting because of the different drying technology that the dishwasher uses. I also like that we can toss silverware into the top drawer without carefully arranging it and it comes out clean. I will admit that my kids and I have watched the countdown on the app on my phone just to see the dishwasher pop itself open at the end of the cycle. My kids named the dishwasher "Cyberdish" because it's so fancy.

Sentence (English): I bought the dishwasher after doing a lot of research and now I realize that I made the best choice.
Comments (English): [ My friend ] || ---------------- || I bought the dishwasher after doing a lot of research and now I realize that I made the best choice. It is quiet, washes well (here with a note -- if you use the appropriate program and temperature for the type of dishes). I can control it from my phone, I am also notified by phone that the program is over or that something is missing (salt, rinse aid, closed water). Drying the dishes at the end of the program is good, but if a small streak remains on a dish, it hardens and is difficult to remove. I think the option to open the door at the end of the program would have been good. Congratulations for the desire to be better for us, the consumers!
Comments (Original): [ Prietena mea ] || ---------------- || Am cumpărat mașina de spălat vase după ce m- am documentat foarte bine și acum realizez că am facut cea mai bună alegere. Este silențioasă, spală bine ( aici cu o mențiune -- dacă folosești programul  și temeratura adecvate pentru tipul de vase ). O pot dirija din telefon, sunt anunțată tot prin telefon că s-a terminat programul sau că lipsește ceva ( sare, soluție de clatire, apa închisă) . Uscarea vaselor la finalul programului este bună, însă, dacă rămâne o mică dungă pe un vas , aceasta se întărește și se ia greu. Cred că ar fi fost bună și opțiunea de deschidere a ușii la finalul programului. Felicitări pentru dorința de a fi mai buni pentru noi , consumatorii !

I cook at home more often than eating out or ordering delivery, to cut down on household expenses! Perhaps that's why, after every meal, the dishwashing bin would pile up with dishes, frying pans, and pots, like homework, taking up a significant portion of my time. ( )bb And while I'm at it, let me explain. Basically, just rinse off any thick seasonings or oil stains, then put it in the dishwasher one by one and run it! Don't use dishwashing detergent or anything else. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent to avoid breakdowns~(whispering) For your information, I use Coupang's own brand of detergent. It's economical in price and feels good to use, so I'm very satisfied. I'm also very satisfied with the cleaning power. After running it in the dishwasher, there's no smell, and the dishes are shinier than when I washed them by hand before! When I touched it, it was so smooth ~_~ that I was secretly surprised. Also, to be honest, I haven't found anything disappointing yet. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - I wanted to explain the key features, so I organized them below myself : ) I classified them into 1~4! It has a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes any remaining bacteria after the dishwashing is finished. This model automatically opens the door after the operation is finished! As soon as it's finished, the door automatically opens to release the heat and steam inside. It is said to have a good design that matches well with any kitchen without any unnecessary things! The sleek and clean white color makes the kitchen brighter, and it is really pretty. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - If my review was even a little helpful or you liked it, please click the [Helpful] button below ('') Always be healthy and happy!

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that is flawless and excellent () ] || ---------------- || This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've always wanted to get a dishwasher, which is often called the "three-generation aunt" in my household, but it always seemed to take a backseat when I was buying other appliances and household items. I cook at home more often than eating out or ordering delivery, to cut down on household expenses! Perhaps that's why, after every meal, the dishwashing bin would pile up with dishes, frying pans, and pots, like homework, taking up a significant portion of my time. But since I got the dishwasher, I've been able to drastically reduce the amount of time I spend doing the dishes by hand! Also, because it's winter, my hands tend to crack and blister a lot more easily. The skin around my fingernails would often swell and bleed. So, what's changed since I got the Media dishwasher? Since the time exposed to water and detergent has been greatly reduced, the skin on my hands has been resting and has become healthier and less chapped than ever, which is great. The installation was done by a professional installer who came to my house on the date and time I specified, and he carefully installed it and kindly explained how to use and maintain it, so I was able to quickly understand the machine. ( )bb And while I'm at it, let me explain. Basically, just rinse off any thick seasonings or oil stains, then put it in the dishwasher one by one and run it! Don't use dishwashing detergent or anything else. Be sure to use a dishwasher-specific detergent to avoid breakdowns~(whispering) For your information, I use Coupang's own brand of detergent. It's economical in price and feels good to use, so I'm very satisfied. I'm also very satisfied with the cleaning power. After running it in the dishwasher, there's no smell, and the dishes are shinier than when I washed them by hand before! When I touched it, it was so smooth ~_~ that I was secretly surprised. Also, to be honest, I haven't found anything disappointing yet. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - I wanted to explain the key features, so I organized them below myself : ) I classified them into 1~4! It has a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes any remaining bacteria after the dishwashing is finished. This model automatically opens the door after the operation is finished! As soon as it's finished, the door automatically opens to release the heat and steam inside. And since it opens right away and dries naturally, it improves hygiene and there's no unpleasant smell :) It's more spacious than I thought for 6 people! The space design is divided into two floors. It is a fairly generous size that can be used by newlyweds or a home with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes a lot of time and consumes electricity >_< However, it is designed to accommodate 6 people, so it is good enough to use in a home with a family~ It has a neat and timeless, luxurious design. It is said to have a good design that matches well with any kitchen without any unnecessary things! The sleek and clean white color makes the kitchen brighter, and it is really pretty. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - If my review was even a little helpful or you liked it, please click the [Helpful] button below ('') Always be healthy and happy!

Comments (English): [ A flawless and excellent dishwasher () ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I had always wanted to get a dishwasher, often referred to as the "three generations of aunts" of the household, but I think I always put it on the back burner because I was busy buying other appliances and household goods. However, thanks to the opportunity to participate in the Coupang Experience Group, I was able to use the Midea dishwasher. I have used it for over a week since installation, and I will write an honest review of my experience! I cook at home overwhelmingly more often than eating out or ordering delivery to save on household food expenses. Perhaps because of this, after every meal, dishes, pans, and pots would pile up in the sink like homework, taking up a significant portion of my day. However, since getting the dishwasher, I have been able to drastically reduce the time spent washing dishes by hand! Also, because it is winter, my hands used to crack much more easily, swell up, and the skin around my fingernails would often peel and bleed. Since getting the Midea dishwasher, the time my hands are exposed to water and detergent has decreased significantly... In the meantime, my hand skin has had a rest, and it is becoming healthier and less chapped than ever before, which is absolutely wonderful. A professional installer coordinated the visit time with the date I specified and arrived at my home right on time. They installed it meticulously and kindly explained how to use and maintain it, so I was able to understand the machine quickly. ( )bb. And while I'm at it, let me explain: basically, you just need to rinse off thick sauces or grease, then neatly stack the dishes and run the cycle! You must not use regular dish soap or anything else; you absolutely MUST use dishwasher-specific detergent to prevent it from breaking down. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Personally, I was also very satisfied with the cleaning power. When I take the dishes out after running the cycle, there is no smell, and they shine much brighter than when I used to wash them by hand! I was actually surprised because it felt squeaky clean to the touch. Also, honestly, I haven't found anything to complain about yet. Since I was at it, I wanted to explain the key features as well. I've summarized them myself below : ) I've categorized them into points 1 through 4! It features a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes residual bacteria after the dishwashing cycle is finished. It is a model that opens the door automatically after operation is complete! As soon as it finishes, the door opens automatically to release the heat and steam from inside. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! The space is also designed with two levels. It is quite a generous size, making it suitable for newlyweds or families with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes up a lot of time and consumes electricity >_<. However, since it is generously designed for 6 people, it is perfect for households living with family. It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. Comments (English): [ A flawless and excellent dishwasher () ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event. I had always wanted to get a dishwasher, often referred to as the "three generations of aunts" of the household, but I think I always put it on the back burner because I was busy buying other appliances and household goods. However, thanks to the opportunity to participate in the Coupang Experience Group, I was able to use the Midea dishwasher. I have used it for over a week since installation, and I will write an honest review of my experience! I cook at home overwhelmingly more often than eating out or ordering delivery to save on household food expenses. Perhaps because of this, after every meal, dishes, pans, and pots would pile up in the sink like homework, taking up a significant portion of my day. However, since getting the dishwasher, I have been able to drastically reduce the time spent washing dishes by hand! Also, because it is winter, my hands used to crack much more easily, swell up, and the skin around my fingernails would often peel and bleed. Since getting the Midea dishwasher, the time my hands are exposed to water and detergent has decreased significantly... In the meantime, my hand skin has had a rest, and it is becoming healthier and less chapped than ever before, which is absolutely wonderful. A professional installer coordinated the visit time with the date I specified and arrived at my home right on time. They installed it meticulously and kindly explained how to use and maintain it, so I was able to understand the machine quickly. ( )bb. And while I'm at it, let me explain: basically, you just need to rinse off thick sauces or grease, then neatly stack the dishes and run the cycle! You must not use regular dish soap or anything else; you absolutely MUST use dishwasher-specific detergent to prevent it from breaking down. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Personally, I was also very satisfied with the cleaning power. When I take the dishes out after running the cycle, there is no smell, and they shine much brighter than when I used to wash them by hand! I was actually surprised because it felt squeaky clean to the touch. Also, honestly, I haven't found anything to complain about yet. Since I was at it, I wanted to explain the key features as well. I've summarized them myself below : ) I've categorized them into points 1 through 4! It features a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes residual bacteria after the dishwashing cycle is finished. It is a model that opens the door automatically after operation is complete! As soon as it finishes, the door opens automatically to release the heat and steam from inside. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! The space is also designed with two levels. It is quite a generous size, making it suitable for newlyweds or families with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes up a lot of time and consumes electricity >_<. However, since it is generously designed for 6 people, it is perfect for households living with family. It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. However, since getting the dishwasher, I have been able to drastically reduce the time spent washing dishes by hand! In the meantime, my hand skin has had a rest, and it is becoming healthier and less chapped than ever before, which is absolutely wonderful. A professional installer coordinated the visit time with the date I specified and arrived at my home right on time. You must not use regular dish soap or anything else; you absolutely MUST use dishwasher-specific detergent to prevent it from breaking down. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Personally, I was also very satisfied with the cleaning power. When I take the dishes out after running the cycle, there is no smell, and they shine much brighter than when I used to wash them by hand! I was actually surprised because it felt squeaky clean to the touch. Also, honestly, I haven't found anything to complain about yet. Since I was at it, I wanted to explain the key features as well. I've summarized them myself below : ) I've categorized them into points 1 through 4! It features a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes residual bacteria after the dishwashing cycle is finished. It is a model that opens the door automatically after operation is complete! As soon as it finishes, the door opens automatically to release the heat and steam from inside. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! The space is also designed with two levels. It is quite a generous size, making it suitable for newlyweds or families with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes up a lot of time and consumes electricity >_<. However, since it is generously designed for 6 people, it is perfect for households living with family. It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. However, since getting the dishwasher, I have been able to drastically reduce the time spent washing dishes by hand! In the meantime, my hand skin has had a rest, and it is becoming healthier and less chapped than ever before, which is absolutely wonderful. You must not use regular dish soap or anything else; you absolutely MUST use dishwasher-specific detergent to prevent it from breaking down. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Personally, I was also very satisfied with the cleaning power. When I take the dishes out after running the cycle, there is no smell, and they shine much brighter than when I used to wash them by hand! I was actually surprised because it felt squeaky clean to the touch. Also, honestly, I haven't found anything to complain about yet. Since I was at it, I wanted to explain the key features as well. I've summarized them myself below : ) I've categorized them into points 1 through 4! It features a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes residual bacteria after the dishwashing cycle is finished. It is a model that opens the door automatically after operation is complete! As soon as it finishes, the door opens automatically to release the heat and steam from inside. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! The space is also designed with two levels. It is quite a generous size, making it suitable for newlyweds or families with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes up a lot of time and consumes electricity >_<. However, since it is generously designed for 6 people, it is perfect for households living with family. It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. I cook at home overwhelmingly more often than eating out or ordering delivery to save on household food expenses. Perhaps because of this, after every meal, dishes, pans, and pots would pile up in the sink like homework, taking up a significant portion of my day. However, since getting the dishwasher, I have been able to drastically reduce the time spent washing dishes by hand! Also, because it is winter, my hands used to crack much more easily, swell up, and the skin around my fingernails would often peel and bleed. In the meantime, my hand skin has had a rest, and it is becoming healthier and less chapped than ever before, which is absolutely wonderful. A professional installer coordinated the visit time with the date I specified and arrived at my home right on time. They installed it meticulously and kindly explained how to use and maintain it, so I was able to understand the machine quickly. ( )bb. And while I'm at it, let me explain: basically, you just need to rinse off thick sauces or grease, then neatly stack the dishes and run the cycle! You must not use regular dish soap or anything else; you absolutely MUST use dishwasher-specific detergent to prevent it from breaking down. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Personally, I was also very satisfied with the cleaning power. When I take the dishes out after running the cycle, there is no smell, and they shine much brighter than when I used to wash them by hand! I was actually surprised because it felt squeaky clean to the touch. Also, honestly, I haven't found anything to complain about yet. Since I was at it, I wanted to explain the key features as well. I've summarized them myself below : ) I've categorized them into points 1 through 4! It features a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes residual bacteria after the dishwashing cycle is finished. It is a model that opens the door automatically after operation is complete! As soon as it finishes, the door opens automatically to release the heat and steam from inside. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! The space is also designed with two levels. It is quite a generous size, making it suitable for newlyweds or families with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes up a lot of time and consumes electricity >_<. However, since it is generously designed for 6 people, it is perfect for households living with family. It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. However, since getting the dishwasher, I have been able to drastically reduce the time spent washing dishes by hand! Also, because it is winter, my hands used to crack much more easily, swell up, and the skin around my fingernails would often peel and bleed. In the meantime, my hand skin has had a rest, and it is becoming healthier and less chapped than ever before, which is absolutely wonderful. A professional installer coordinated the visit time with the date I specified and arrived at my home right on time. They installed it meticulously and kindly explained how to use and maintain it, so I was able to understand the machine quickly. ( )bb. And while I'm at it, let me explain: basically, you just need to rinse off thick sauces or grease, then neatly stack the dishes and run the cycle! You must not use regular dish soap or anything else; you absolutely MUST use dishwasher-specific detergent to prevent it from breaking down. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Personally, I was also very satisfied with the cleaning power. When I take the dishes out after running the cycle, there is no smell, and they shine much brighter than when I used to wash them by hand! I was actually surprised because it felt squeaky clean to the touch. Also, honestly, I haven't found anything to complain about yet. Since I was at it, I wanted to explain the key features as well. I've summarized them myself below : ) I've categorized them into points 1 through 4! It features a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes residual bacteria after the dishwashing cycle is finished. It is a model that opens the door automatically after operation is complete! As soon as it finishes, the door opens automatically to release the heat and steam from inside. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! The space is also designed with two levels. It is quite a generous size, making it suitable for newlyweds or families with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes up a lot of time and consumes electricity >_<. However, since it is generously designed for 6 people, it is perfect for households living with family. It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. In the meantime, my hand skin has had a rest, and it is becoming healthier and less chapped than ever before, which is absolutely wonderful. They installed it meticulously and kindly explained how to use and maintain it, so I was able to understand the machine quickly. ( )bb. You must not use regular dish soap or anything else; you absolutely MUST use dishwasher-specific detergent to prevent it from breaking down. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Personally, I was also very satisfied with the cleaning power. When I take the dishes out after running the cycle, there is no smell, and they shine much brighter than when I used to wash them by hand! I was actually surprised because it felt squeaky clean to the touch. Also, honestly, I haven't found anything to complain about yet. Since I was at it, I wanted to explain the key features as well. I've summarized them myself below : ) I've categorized them into points 1 through 4! It features a UV lamp function! The UV lamp function effectively removes residual bacteria after the dishwashing cycle is finished. It is a model that opens the door automatically after operation is complete! As soon as it finishes, the door opens automatically to release the heat and steam from inside. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! The space is also designed with two levels. It is quite a generous size, making it suitable for newlyweds or families with children. Washing dishes multiple times takes up a lot of time and consumes electricity >_<. However, since it is generously designed for 6 people, it is perfect for households living with family. It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. (Whispering) For reference, I bought and am using Coupang's own brand dedicated detergent. It is economical in terms of price and feels great to use, so I am very satisfied. Since it opens right away for natural drying, it enhances hygiene and prevents any unpleasant odors from lingering :). It is a 6-place setting, which is more spacious than expected! It features a clean, timeless, and luxurious design. I rate the design as excellent enough to blend seamlessly into any kitchen without looking out of place! The elegant and clean white color makes the kitchen seem brighter, and it is truly beautiful. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -. While one man came in and removed the old dishwasher, the other guy unpacked the new dishwasher in the middle of the street. He flipped the new dishwasher from side-to-side in the street while attaching hoses. While he avoided dings and scratches on the door of the washer, there were several dings to the sides and back of the dishwasher. The door of the dishwasher is just slightly twisted, but still opens and closes okay. The installer answered a couple of questions about the washer and then turned around and walked out. Great product. not a great install.

I used a 6-person product from another brand, but when I used a 14-person product, it became a large pot. ] || ---------------- || There was an additional installation cost, but since it was a technical part, I was satisfied with the installation. Of course, the technician was also kind. I used to use a 6-person product from another brand, but when I used a 14-person product, I felt twice as satisfied with the large pot. They say it's best to buy home appliances tomorrow, but I can use it today and be satisfied. However, since arranging the dishes without hitting each other on the tightly structured fixtures requires individual Tetris skills, it seems that there is a factor that dishwashers will develop in the future. When I first used it, I felt that arranging the dishes was difficult compared to the 6-person I was used to, so I arranged them haphazardly and ended up using the 14-person as a 6-person. After using it for over a month, the spacing between the dishes became a little tighter, so I think I can use it for 8 people. (For reference, I'm not the main user.) If you have the space depending on the structure of your house, it might be a good idea to install it as an external cabinet. When installing it internally, you will naturally have to give up some storage space. Nevertheless, the dishwasher is definitely worth bringing into the house. I am using it after larvae, but it definitely plays a role in sharing the work that I put into the housework. It would be more convenient if I used it without larvae, but I am still not in the mood, so I don't think I can properly utilize 1/3 of the efficiency. The other advantage of larvae is that it is almost impossible to clean the inside, so there is not much need for cleaning. I think this review became a rambling one because I included my personal opinions, but I think it was worth writing if it was of some help to someone who is considering buying it^^;. * I thought there was no mute function for a month, so I had to catch my baby who was running when I heard the guide sound and drop him. It has a mute function. You can also adjust the volume. There is a button method, but it is convenient to set it through the app, so if you didn't know about it, please use it.
Comments (Original): [ 설치 추가비용은 발생했지만, 기술적 부분이 필요한 부분이라 만족스럽게 설치했습니다. 물론 기사님도 친절하셨습니다.6인용 타 브랜드 제품을 쓰다가,14인용을 쓰니 큰냄비가 되는 것에 ] || ---------------- || 설치 추가비용은 발생했지만, 기술적 부분이 필요한 부분이라 만족스럽게 설치했습니다. 물론 기사님도 친절하셨습니다.6인용 타 브랜드 제품을 쓰다가,14인용을 쓰니 큰냄비가 되는 것에서 만족도는 2배를 체감하게 되네요.가전제품은 내일 사는게 제일 좋다고 하지만,오늘 사도 충분히 만족하고 사용할 수 있겠습니다.다만 촘촘하게 구성된 고정대에 그릇이 부딪히지 않게  배치하는 것은 개개인의 테트리스 스킬을 요하는 점에 있어서 앞으로 식기세척기가 발전해갈 요인이 있어보이긴 합니다. 첫 사용에서는 익숙하게 쓰던 6인용에 비해 그릇 배치가 난해하게 느껴져서 얼기설기 배치하니 14인용을 6인용으로 활용하게 되더군요.. 한달 넘게 사용기간이 되니, 조금 더 배치 간격이 좁아져서 8인용 정도까지는 활용하는 수준이 된 것 같습니다.(참고로 주 사용자가 아님)집 구조에 따라 여유가 있다면, 외부 장으로 설치하는 것도 좋은 방법일 듯 합니다.내부로 설치할 때는 당연하게도 일부 수납공간을 포기해야합니다.그럼에도 불구하고 식기세척기는 집에 들일 분명한 가치가 있긴 합니다.애벌을 해서 쓰고 있긴 하지만, 집안 일에 들이는 수고를 분담해주는 역할이 분명합니다.만약 애벌하지 않고 사용한다면 더욱 편리하겠으나아직은 마음이 내키지 않으니 1/3의 효율만큼은 제대로 활용은 못하는 것 같긴합니다.애벌로 인한 반면의 장점은 내부 청소를 거의 안해도 무방함에 가까워서 세척관리가 그다지 필요없다는 것입니다.개인사용 의견을 담다보니 주절주절 떠드는 리뷰가 된 것 같습니다만, 구매를 고민하는 누군가에게 조금의 도움이라도 된다면 작성한 보람이 있겠지 싶습니다^^;* 한달동안 무음기능이 없는 줄 알고 안내음을 들으면 달려가는 아기 붙잡고 떨어뜨리는 수고가 있었습니다.무음기능 됩니다. 볼륨 조절도 됩니다. 버튼으로 쓰는 방식도 있으나 앱 통해서 설정 편리하게 되니 혹시나 모르셨던 분들은 꼭 이용하세요 ㅎㅎ

Comments (Original): [ 설치 추가비용은 발생했지만, 기술적 부분이 필요한 부분이라 만족스럽게 설치했습니다. 물론 기사님도 친절하셨습니다.6인용 타 브랜드 제품을 쓰다가,14인용을 쓰니 큰냄비가 되는 것에 ] || ---------------- || 설치 추가비용은 발생했지만, 기술적 부분이 필요한 부분이라 만족스럽게 설치했습니다. 물론 기사님도 친절하셨습니다.6인용 타 브랜드 제품을 쓰다가,14인용을 쓰니 큰냄비가 되는 것에서 만족도는 2배를 체감하게 되네요.가전제품은 내일 사는게 제일 좋다고 하지만,오늘 사도 충분히 만족하고 사용할 수 있겠습니다.다만 촘촘하게 구성된 고정대에 그릇이 부딪히지 않게  배치하는 것은 개개인의 테트리스 스킬을 요하는 점에 있어서 앞으로 식기세척기가 발전해갈 요인이 있어보이긴 합니다. 첫 사용에서는 익숙하게 쓰던 6인용에 비해 그릇 배치가 난해하게 느껴져서 얼기설기 배치하니 14인용을 6인용으로 활용하게 되더군요.. 한달 넘게 사용기간이 되니, 조금 더 배치 간격이 좁아져서 8인용 정도까지는 활용하는 수준이 된 것 같습니다.(참고로 주 사용자가 아님)집 구조에 따라 여유가 있다면, 외부 장으로 설치하는 것도 좋은 방법일 듯 합니다.내부로 설치할 때는 당연하게도 일부 수납공간을 포기해야합니다.그럼에도 불구하고 식기세척기는 집에 들일 분명한 가치가 있긴 합니다.애벌을 해서 쓰고 있긴 하지만, 집안 일에 들이는 수고를 분담해주는 역할이 분명합니다.만약 애벌하지 않고 사용한다면 더욱 편리하겠으나아직은 마음이 내키지 않으니 1/3의 효율만큼은 제대로 활용은 못하는 것 같긴합니다.애벌로 인한 반면의 장점은 내부 청소를 거의 안해도 무방함에 가까워서 세척관리가 그다지 필요없다는 것입니다.개인사용 의견을 담다보니 주절주절 떠드는 리뷰가 된 것 같습니다만, 구매를 고민하는 누군가에게 조금의 도움이라도 된다면 작성한 보람이 있겠지 싶습니다^^;* 한달동안 무음기능이 없는 줄 알고 안내음을 들으면 달려가는 아기 붙잡고 떨어뜨리는 수고가 있었습니다.무음기능 됩니다. 볼륨 조절도 됩니다. 버튼으로 쓰는 방식도 있으나 앱 통해서 설정 편리하게 되니 혹시나 모르셨던 분들은 꼭 이용하세요 ㅎㅎ

Sentence (English): I bought the 604 Kitchenaid dishwasher (D), and it is amazing.
Comments (English): [ Great Choice for my Family ] || ---------------- || I bought the 604 Kitchenaid dishwasher (D), and it is amazing. I am 60 years old and I have had many many D in my 40 year marriage, but this one is the best with the 3rd rack that holds cups and glasses! (I load mugs in the middle tray) We are a family of 4 and I run 1 load every single day of the week! Before I used to load my D and then be left with extra items, then I used to have to re-adjust the items I already loaded to try to fit in the items that were still outside the D. It felt like a puzzle trying to make everything fit. Not anymore, I load it and usually I simply run it on "Pro Wash". The directions say I do NOT need to rinse my dishes. But I am in the habit of rinsing every item before I load it, most likely because I always felt my previous D did not do an excellent job. I have used the Kitchenaid D for 1 month, and every item is sparkling clean after the cycle! Before, once in awhile, I used to get an item that was not 100% clean, so I would need to lightly scrub and rewash in the next cycle. Not anymore. So far, every item has come out 100% spotless. I inspect every single item I pull out of the D! It is very satisfying to have 100% sparking clean items! I have a bedroom right next to the kitchen, and the D is quiet enough not to disturb my daughter. Last Sat, I turned on the D while my husband and I cooked, and the D was quiet enough it did not bother our conversation. I thought I needed a quieter decibel, but even though I have hardwood floors in my home, the noise does not travel out of the kitchen. Noise is really not an issue anymore, and our house is an older 1300 sq ft with mostely and open floor plan.I had to chose between a Bosh that was super at drying and super quiet decibel, but it had a lower load capacity, but for me I need the ability to load everything in 1 load. Mostly I throw in everything including the pots and pans and all plastics. I love to see my kitchen counters clean and empty, I do not even like to have clean dishes drying on the rack, so having the ability to load everything is perfect for me. Noise is not an issue, and if it ever was and issue, the D has a timer so I can run it when I leave to work if I wanted to. But so far, I just run it with no noise problems at all. My only reservation is there is a bit of water on top of the cups sometimes depending on the cup construction, and the tupperware plastics are slightly wet, but I usually use 1 paper towel to slightly wipe these items as I am storing them away, it is not a big deal for me at all. Since the paper towel is wet but clean, I lay it out to dry and reuse it. I hope this is helpful to someone.

Sentence (English): I have had the Bosch 500 for about 3 months.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I have had the Bosch 500 for about 3 months. It is a well made, high quality machine, and I have not had any problems with it. Pros: the 3rd tray is very handy for silverware and service utensils or flat lids. I use it all the time and fill it up since the silverware basket is small. The racks are well laid out and hold a lot of dishes. The machine cleans really well with commercial detergent and rinse aid. There is a red light that indicates when the machine is on. My husband is a contractor and said it's the easiest machine he's ever installed. The machine is very quiet. There is not an exposed heating element which can melt plastic. You can download an app and run the machine from it but I haven't used this feature yet. Cons: Some mugs or bowls are still a little wet or hold water if there are ridges, but I was used to this already and it doesn't bother me. I believe there is an option to add additional heat but I don't feel it's necessary. They reduced the size of the utensil basket. It's about 1/2 of a normal size. You can buy a full size basket off Amazon for $40 if you have a large family and need it. Overall I am really happy with my purchase and would buy it again bc I believe Bosch to be a high quality brand.

Comments (English): [ great cleaning with some downsides ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher does a pretty great job at cleaning dishes. I am a bit disappointed that it is only 2 levels but I've gotten more creative about stacking and/or nesting when needed. But the 2 levels has an unexpected benefit that we can put tall things in either the top or the bottom.We have hard water so the heating element was quickly becoming caked with calcium deposits. The product "LemiShine" in every load seems to reduce this but the heater element STILL stinks every time the dishwasher is opened (at first). Eventually the odor dissipates but it still feels like an oversight.The settings are o.k. but there's not much variety and there is no easily marked "Low energy" mode. I also have to push three buttons every time I want to start it because I don't want the heater mode on (the odor seems stronger and it feels like wasted energy) long or short mode. It would be much nicer if it remembered my previous wash cycle's settings so I didn't have to repeatedly press all those buttons.Cleaning out the filter is a dream, though! No more scrubbing required! Fingers crossed this lasts us for years.
